recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-7878 unless a future work group decision changes the Attachment contentType/data/url rule itself.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive DSTU1 correction asking that Attachment.contentType documentation stop saying the element SHALL always be populated and instead agree with the formal cardinality and structure rule.
initial_application: The issue was applied by SVN-backed git commit 5ae1eebfcac2835ff22fdbbc1cdfb452b33ab838 (#7878, svn r5937), which changed source/datatypes.html so contentType is required only when an Attachment contains data and may be present for url-only attachments.
additional_context: FHIR-3279 had previously made Attachment.contentType 0..1 with the data-only invariant. source/fhir.ini keeps Attachment in the active [types] list, maps datatypes to datatypes.html, and carries current normative/abbreviation metadata. FHIR-13128 later corrected a typo in the same invariant text without changing the requirement and is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/datatypes.html states contentType SHALL be populated when data is present and MAY be populated when url is present, while source/datatypes/attachment.xml has cardinality 0..1 and invariant data.empty() or contentType.exists().

related_jiras.note: Made Attachment.contentType optional except when inline data is present, establishing the formal rule that FHIR-7878 aligned the prose with.
Corrected a typo in the same Attachment invariant text without changing the requirement; it is already audited on the combined branch.
